programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Flying over the Himalayan foothills on a short hop from the Nepali capital Kathmandu to the tourist city of Pokhara, Yeti Airlines Flight 691 is cleared to land. And while a passenger live streams the final approach—and just seconds from the runway—the plane stalls and crashes into a gorge. Destroyed on impact, investigators find a scene of utter annihilation at the crash site. Eyewitness video gives them their first lead—the aircraft came in at a severe left bank. And the wreckage indicates the engines were in the feathered position, and therefore unable to provide thrust. A deep dive soon proves their was nothing wrong with the plane. And when investigators listen to the CVR, they're stunned to uncover overloaded pilots and a fatal case of mistaken identity.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Radio silence between pilots and air traffic controllers can mean many different things, but only the physical evidence can reveal the true story. Three shocking cases send investigators hunting for answers. A Greek airliner goes rogue and crashes outside Athens. A China Airlines 747 disappears from radar and the culprit is discovered on the ocean floor. And, when controllers lose contact with a private jet, fighter planes scramble to intervene.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: Spatial disorientation is one of the leading causes of all air accidents. Even the most experienced pilots are susceptible to its subtle yet deadly effects. A confused John F. Kennedy Jr. disappears on the way to Martha's Vineyard. High over the Red Sea, a captain loses his bearings and crashes his passenger jet. And, off the coast of Indonesia, pilots fly their Boeing 737 into a violent storm and end up on the ocean floor.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: A quiet day turns tense as drug traffickers lead the Coastguard's boats and helicopters on a high-speed chase as they try to reach Moroccan waters, where the Spanish teams have no jurisdiction. An illegal fishing boat has entered a protected nature reserve and must be stopped. And a distress call comes in for a dinghy drifting in dangerous waters with 14 people onboard.

programme.title: Border Protection Spain
programme.desc: During the night, a call from a distressed mother alerts the Coastguard to a potential suicide attempt in a treacherous area. Aided by helicopters, a team intercepts drug traffickers carrying over 3 tons of hashish. Fishermen using illegal devices try to fish in protected waters and a German sailboat raises suspicion.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: This season Gordon is on culinary mission as he dives, fishes and forages across the world. From hand-catching rattlesnakes in Texas, to fighting waves hunting for barnacles in Portugal, Ramsay's adventure takes him: lobstering in Maine; moonshining in the Smokey Mountains; rappelling for shrimp in Puerto Rico; bread making in Iceland's volcanic sands; wrestling with conga eels in Croatia; and scaling cliffs for butterworms and honey ants in Mexico.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon explores the enchanted island of Puerto Rico; from the bright blue sea to the lush mountains of the interior. Along the way he learns about Hurricane Maria's recent devastating toll on the island, and how food shortages have prompted locals to push for food independence. On this epic adventure, Gordon goes spearfishing, takes a helicopter ride to an organic coffee plantation, and rappels down a waterfall for delicious river shrimp.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: Duty Manager Dan must deal with a check-in outage at the start of the busy school holidays. Airside Safety responds to a life-or-death medical emergency on an incoming flight. 68 racehorses valued at $300 million dollars arrive from Europe. Overnight, the airside lighting team carry out vital work while dodging planes.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: A Bali-bound flight faces delays after a service truck crashes into its undercarriage. Australian Border Force find illegal weapons in a passenger's luggage. Unregistered taxi drivers are caught in the act and there's a fuel leak on the tarmac. At night, a mysterious Soviet-era plane lands unannounced.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Inside Melbourne Airport
programme.desc: On his first day, Australian Border Force recruit Nelson makes a find. A daring pushback trial ten years in the making involving multiple aircraft is under threat. Baggage manager Brodie faces the challenge of handling 2,000 bags during a system upgrade. A father and son pilot duo tackle a new flight simulator.

programme.title: Sally
programme.desc: Sally Ride became the first American woman to blast off into space, but beneath her unflappable composure, she carried a secret. Revealing the romance and sacrifices of their 27 years together, Sally's life partner, Tam O'Shaughnessy, tells the full story of this complicated and iconic astronaut for the first time. SALLY is directed by Emmy Award-winning filmmaker Cristina Costantini.

programme.title: Love+War
programme.desc: Pulitzer Prize-winning photographer Lynsey Addario risks her life in the male-dominated world of conflict photography, capturing the realities of war. But each assignment means stepping into danger and leaving behind her husband and two young sons. Behind the camera, Addario is torn between her commitment to the essential work of journalism and the powerful, competing demands of motherhood.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Journey through the unforgiving and inhospitable climate of Norway's frozen mountains with the elite rescue crews who come to the aid of stranded travellers and battle round-the-clock to maintain access to vital road links. With sudden changes in the weather, from torrential rain to snow blizzards and sudden temperature changes, the teams have their work cut out for them. Risking life and limb in some of Europe's harshest conditions, it takes a special breed of men and women to overcome the many challenges thay face on a daily basis. As the roads turn into icy bobsleigh tracks, haulage container vehicles and private cars and vans all get themselves into difficulties and need to be rescued by our road warrior heroes.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.title: North Korea: Inside the Mind of A Dictator
programme.desc: This two-part documentary takes a close look at the hermit kingdom of Kim Jong-Un's North Korea. Featuring insight, analysis and opinion from political, social, and economic experts of the country, this programme chronicles the last three volatile years of Kim's rule as he tries to maintain control of his dysfunctional regime while promoting North Korea's diplomatic influence on the world stage. Will he be successful in achieving sanction relief?

programme.title: North Korea: Inside the Mind of A Dictator
programme.desc: A follow up to the limited docuseries, Inside North Korea's Dynasty, which aired in 2019. National Geographic Documentary Films presents two special episodes that examine the extra ordinary history of the world's only communist dynasty, three generations in the making.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Chemicals. Garbage. Fish. A trucker needing a rescue isn't concerned about just his rig. The truck's cargo is another big worry. Stig is sent to rescue an animal transport carrying live pigs that got stuck in a ditch, Thord heads out to rescue a truck carrying hot asphalt that tipped when it moved over for oncoming traffic, on another rescue Thord races against time to rescue a truck carrying thousands of euros worth of fish.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: It's not just rookie drivers who make mistakes on treacherous journeys. Sometimes it's the rescuers who are rookies and learning the ropes. In this episode, Thord and Erlend rescue a 50-ton truck that took a steep hill too fast, Bjoern comes to the aid of a truck blocking a tunnel because the driver didn't use chains, Ole Henrik's new recruit Stig is in charge of a rescue operation but has to call in the boss.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc!
programme.desc: Winter brings chaos to roads around the world. In the United States, men and women brave treacherous roads to rescue stranded drivers and recover heavy-duty wrecks. Ice Road Rescue: Highway Havoc! is a 2-part compilation series that tells the stories of the most dangerous recoveries, largest payloads and harrowing rescues featured in Ice Road Rescue (Norway). Tow operators face brutal weather and terrifying situations as they rescue everything from cargo worth thousands of dollars to people to the burned-out shells of semi-trucks. Each episode shows the skill, dedication and courage of the operators who risk it all to keep the roads open.

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: It is believed the Hadza people have lived in Tanzania's Great Rift Valley for tens of thousands of years, and they've maintained their hunter-gatherer way of life for just as long. Adventurer and YouTuber Eva zu Beck visits the Hadza and attempts to learn their superskills. First, she hunts with the men using homemade bows and arrows. Then she forages with the women, collecting baobab fruit and digging for tubers using sticks as shovels. On her final day at the Hadza camp, Eva must combine what she's learned to subsist for a full 24 hours on her own in the Tanzanian bush. But going it alone is much harder than she anticipates, and Eva realizes that for the Hazda, survival isn't meant to be a solitary endeavor.

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: Explorer Eva zu Beck travels to Iten, Kenya - the legendary "Home of Champions" known for producing the fastest long-distance runners in history - for an intense, one-week running training camp. Watch as she immerses herself in the Kenyan running culture to learn the secrets of elite marathon runners and world champion athletes in this high-altitude training mecca. With a Kenyan Olympian as a coach, Eva sets out on her mission to become a faster runner and significantly improve her marathon time through training techniques, a specialized running diet, daily schedule, and powerful mindset that separates the best from the rest.

programme.title: Superskilled with Eva Zu Beck
programme.desc: Eva zu Beck travels to the Amazon to meet members of the Yukuna Indigenous community in Leticia, Colombia. Traditionally, the culture still practices plant-based medicine and many protective and healing rituals, some involving pain as a way to increase resilience. Her guide is Fermín, a shaman who is a respected expert in Yukuna culture. His welcome immediately tests her ability to endure some discomfort. This would only serve as a small glimpse into the pain ritual Eva came to experience with a species native to the Amazon: the bullet ant. Throughout the experience, she second-guesses her decision to be bitten by a handful of bullet ants. She channels the Yukuna culture while attempting to manage a pain like she's never experienced before.

programme.title: Pole to Pole with Will Smith
programme.desc: Will, Bryan and Carla join local Waorani elder Penti Baihua in the Amazon, in search of the world's biggest snake: the giant green anaconda. They carefully remove just one scale from the 17-foot snake's skin. Will's fear turns into relief, then joy. The single scale can reveal the health of the entire ecosystem — crucial for the future of both wildlife and the Waorani.

programme.title: Underworld, Inc.
programme.desc: For migrants crossing illegally from Mexico to the United States, surviving in the desert alone can be a brutal experience. But add to that threats from people traffickers, many of whom are affiliated with cartels, and immigrants can face extortion, miserable conditions at "stash houses" and sometimes even being forced into prostitution. Once in the traffickers clutches, migrants become a sort of human cargo, treated as nothing but business assets to the ruthless organized criminals holding them hostage. This story is told from the inside, in the words of the migrants and from the mouths of the people smuggling foot soldiers.

programme.title: Underworld, Inc.
programme.desc: From the illegal weapons to the underground sex trade, nothing is off limits and everything is for sale in illegal, underground markets. It's an industry that is brutal, exploitative, and corrupt where what you buy isn't always what it seems. Despite efforts to crack down on these illegal trades, more than $625 billion makes it's way into the US economy each year for illegal trade goods. Unprecedented inside access brings light to the inner workings of the last bastion of 'free' enterprise, charting a global path to the underworld economy. Workers, suppliers, sellers, customers – and the law enforcement trying to keep it in check - share their experience of a hidden world that touches us all.

programme.title: Underworld, Inc.
programme.desc: Millions of Americans love to gamble. But some forms of gambling are restricted or illegal, pushing them underground, where the rules are very different. Here if you want to play you have to pay. The bookie will extend credit, but "miss a week, you miss a finger." Or worse. In the shadows of the law, people will bet on anything; legal or illegal. Innocent lives are put at risk in a world where only one thing matters: money.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon explores Oaxaca, a Mexican city steeped in history and tradition, on a mission to unlock the secrets of the region's famous cuisine. Gordon scales cliffs on the hunt for edible insects, chops down agave in the sweltering heat and learns how to make mole with a master. After a week of adventures, Gordon goes head to head with one of Mexico's top-rated chefs, Gabriela Cámara, to put his newfound skills to the test.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Uncharted
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsey sets out on a journey to some of the worlds most remote locations, where he'll be looking for an adventure of the culinary kind. Basking in the culture of each setting he ends up, his cooking has never been more inspired than when on such an adventure. Whether he's cooking at altitude in Peru or educating himself on Alaskan cuisine, Gordon is experiencing the world like never before and beautifully curating a delicious morsel for each setting. It's a far cry from the professional kitchen he's used to and he's handling ingredients that are completely new, but the food doesn't get better than this.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Port Protection is home to the few who have left behind normal society and chosen a different life in a remote Alaskan community, where survival of the individuals and community cannot sustain without the other. The stakes are high. The land is rugged and unforgiving and the seas which surround Port Protection are cold and merciless. With risk comes a reward more profound than mere survival: a world of beauty and freedom with the security of community and without the constraints of bureaucracy. In Port Protection there are no clear roads to survival, inhabitants must carve one themselves.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: The residences come together, combining old wisdom with youthful strength to ensure the future of Port Protection. Sam, Carl and Troy build a vital log hauler for their future homesteads. Curly is hungry for some heart and liver, so he hunts the rainforest for a young buck. Squibb and Chris build a significant upgrade to their infrastructure. Oliver and Breanna continue on their quest to harvest a bear.

programme.title: Lawless Island
programme.desc: Port Protection is home to the few who have left behind normal society and chosen a different life in a remote Alaskan community, where survival of the individuals and community cannot sustain without the other. The stakes are high. The land is rugged and unforgiving and the seas which surround Port Protection are cold and merciless. With risk comes a reward more profound than mere survival: a world of beauty and freedom with the security of community and without the constraints of bureaucracy. In Port Protection there are no clear roads to survival, inhabitants must carve one themselves.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz are off to Dorset to pick up a Ford Escort MK2 RS2000. The car belongs to self-employed carpenter Mike. After his son was involved in an horrific road accident Mike gave up work and supported him through a four year recovery. Now Mike's family want to give something back to say thank you to this devoted father and what better thankyou than to present him with his fully restored RS 2000?

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Brand new: Tim Shaw and Fuzz Townshend are off to Loughborough to take on a 1992 Saab 900 Turbo that's in desperate need of repair. The car belongs to Saab enthusiast and former electrical engineer Pravesh. Sadly, due to ill health, Pravesh has been left with little strength to work on the car, so it's been left to rot. His family believe getting his Saab back on the road would give him the boost he needs.

programme.title: Car S.O.S.
programme.desc: Tim and Fuzz head to Scotland to take on a 1993 Toyota Supra Mk.4 owned by former competitive motorcycle racer Lisa, who after a road accident is no longer able to ride her beloved bikes. Along came her Japanese supercar which helped fulfil her need for speed. Ongoing mobility problems have meant the car has ended in need of TLC. Lisa's friends and family hope a fully restored car will lift her spirits.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: Amsterdam is celebrating its 750th anniversary, and Amsterdam Central Station stands at the heart of the festivities. Alongside the city's milestone, station manager René marks 25 years of service. Ticket & Service employees Gusta and Alexandra join the anniversary celebrations, while keeping a close eye on autumn showers drifting toward the station. With record crowds pouring in for the historic year, kiosk employee Rosa anxiously awaits a delivery as warehouse worker Ron struggles to stay on schedule. Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran are deployed for the high-risk Ajax-Inter Milan match, where managing supporters proves demanding. And as a fierce autumn storm sweeps through the capital during this landmark celebration, track workers race against time to replace worn rails and keep the anniversary city moving.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: The Christmas holidays begin under extreme conditions as the heaviest snowstorm in 5 years slams into the region, bringing transport to a near standstill. At Central Station, the Christmas spirit descends as thousands of additional holiday passengers are expected despite the weather, turning an already busy period into a logistical battle. Inside the control room, Code Orange is declared as delays cascade across the network. A stalled train compounds the disruption, while platforms grow crowded. Assistant station manager Michel coordinates Christmas decorations while Ticket & Service staff Alexandra and Gusta help create a festive atmosphere. Meanwhile, Safety & Service officers Menno and Baran respond to one incident after another. With snow piling up and pressure mounting, everybody must work together to prevent total gridlock.

programme.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programme.desc: The students face their final test in an iconic head-to-head dogfight against their instructors. To pass, they must bring all the skills they have learned during their advanced phase training. With graduation just days away, students start to worry about their final grades and whether they will get the posting they—and in many cases, their families—want.

programme.title: Top Guns: The Next Generation
programme.desc: In the high-octane competitive world of the U.S. Navy's toughest fighter pilot school, only the strong succeed. This world exclusive takes the viewer inside the final grueling six months of training and selection, where the students learn how to fly combat missions. Dreams of earning strike pilot wings collide with the harsh reality of the most rigorous tests yet. We are inside the cockpit as they tackle adrenaline-fueled, dynamic aerial tests, each designed to push the students to their limits and beyond and not all will pass the test.

programme.title: Airport Security: Colombia
programme.desc: Security officials at El Dorado International Airport, in Bogota, Colombia, continue to foil the most audacious attempts at drug trafficking. On this new season of Airport Alert, they must detect sophisiticated new drug smuggling methods, arrest luggage thieves and detain suspects with international arrest warrants, while also dealing with medical emergencies, document forgery and cases of identity theft. Ranked as one of the 23 best airpots in the world, El Dorado is one of the biggest and most dynamic air terminals in Latin America. The airport serves 25 million passengers and handles 200,000 tons of cargo every year in its 1,100-hectare facility. Things are moving day and night, and appearances can be deceiving. Airport Alert follows agents 24/7 and captures their efforts to ensure the security of passengers and cargo alike.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation Special Report
programme.desc: With airplane travel becoming increasingly popular in a shrinking world and millions of passengers journeying this way every day, it is helpful to be aware of the potentail dangers involved. This show presents remarkable stories of some of the most catastrophic accidents in aviation history and investigates the causes of the accidents, what effect they had on the industry and the steps taken to ensure that they don't happen in the future. Each stand-alone episode features compelling re-enactments, expert analysis and interviews with those involved. The explanations for the accidents range from the explosive power of decompression to problems with autopilots and computerised control systems to air traffic control errors.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Every year, flood risks increase. Across the globe, big cities are experiencing giant storm surges and extreme rainfall, overwhelming natural waterways and drainage systems, catastrophes that rewrite the rules for engineers. In Tokyo, a city already prone to natural disasters, giant rivers are being built underground to cope with raging torrents and typhoons. In Spain, the horror of the Valencia floods has taught authorities the importance of early warning systems when infrastructure fails. In New Orleans, the Army Corps has revolutionized storm surge barriers — but it took the worst flood tragedy in US history to rewrite the future.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the Morandi Bridge collapsed in Genova in 2018, it was more than a national tragedy. Its failure was a reckoning for engineers everywhere and a sobering reminder that every structure has a lifespan. In a world of increasing populations, changing traffic volumes and extreme weather events, how can we safeguard new bridges? Engineers for Genova's new bridge met the challenge, focusing on intelligent safety and advanced robotics. As Turkey builds the longest suspension bridge in the world, engineers push the limits with clever innovations, delivering a modern marvel that withstands wild winds, catastrophic ship collisions and Earth's seismic fury.

programme.title: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
programme.desc: 4000 years ago, in hand-built canoes, people dare to venture into the unexplored Pacific Ocean, searching for islands to start new lives on. Over countless generations they voyage from Taiwan to Vanuatu and beyond. Guided by the sea, stars and the stories of their ancestors, they become master navigators, and unlock a sea of islands. But ocean exploration brings great risks. To overcome merciless natural barriers, these voyagers must deeply understand the brutally powerful Pacific. They build homes on thousands of islands, developing rich cultures filled with song, dance and legends of the sea. But after discovering Fiji, Samoa and Tonga, they find no more islands. Their ocean world remains connected by their canoes, and for 1000 years voyagers sail into unknown, perilous waters, hoping that one day the sea will lead them to new lands.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the truth behind the legends of Hercules. Excavators at Olympia uncover a colossal wall that may shed light on the hero's 12 labors. At Gibraltar, investigators explore a mysterious cavern beneath one of the so-called Pillars of Hercules.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of Ancient Greece
programme.desc: International teams of archaeologists investigate the legacy of one of history's most famous figures: Alexander the Great. New discoveries reveal the architectural wonders of Pella in Greece and Ephesus in Turkey; and in Egypt, archaeologists also uncover a skeleton with terrible injuries. Could it hint at the dark side of this golden age?

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: Executed on charges of adultery and treason, Anne Boleyn is often remembered as the "harlot" who seduced Henry VIII into annulling his first marriage and forcing his country into religious turmoil. By examining what really led to her execution in 1536, Professor Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow reveal a far more complex reality. They discover Anne's appeal to the king was as much intellectual as physical. No mere social climber, she was a moral reformer who sought to use her royal influence for public good. But Anne's power evaporated as her relationship with chief minister Thomas Cromwell fractured and her pregnancies failed to deliver the male heir Henry demanded. Suzannah and Dan uncover evidence that the stunning charges against Anne were falsified; was she actually innocent? This is the story of England's most misunderstood queen.

programme.title: How the Tudors Lost Their Heads
programme.desc: In 1588, Robert Devereux, the Earl of Essex stood beside Elizabeth I as she rallied her troops to face the Spanish Armada. Young and charismatic, he was Elizabeth's intimate confidante, her favourite. But Essex's charm was matched by his recklessness. From arguing with the queen to leading a disastrous military campaign in Ireland, his behaviour pushed the limits of royal patience. Eventually, disgruntled and politically weakened, Essex launched a rebellion that would see him executed. Was he really out to seize the crown? Suzannah Lipscomb and Dan Snow trace the volatile relationship between queen and favourite. Examining centuries-old documents, they uncover evidence-tampering and the devious tactics of an arch-rival, revealing that Essex was undone not only by his own ambition and hotheadedness, but also by ruthless court politics.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: Chemicals. Garbage. Fish. A trucker needing a rescue isn't concerned about just his rig. The truck's cargo is another big worry. Stig is sent to rescue an animal transport carrying live pigs that got stuck in a ditch, Thord heads out to rescue a truck carrying hot asphalt that tipped when it moved over for oncoming traffic, on another rescue Thord races against time to rescue a truck carrying thousands of euros worth of fish.

programme.title: Ice Road Rescue
programme.desc: "Ice Road Rescue" portrays a group of heroic tow truck rescue workers. When winter hits Norway the transport roads turn into treacherous bobsleigh tracks. Every day the rescuers fight to keep this routes open by rescuing heavy trailers stuck in the mountain terrain. Winter storms, avalanches and lack of daylight through the winter season are just some of the challenges they have to face, working close to the polar circle. Extreme winter conditions that often make them risk their lives. "Ice Road Rescue" shows the ultimate man versus nature.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler: Tropical Takedown
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations Puerto Rico arrest 37 members of a smuggling network responsible for multiple murders, and the import and export of cocaine on the island. Air and Marine operations agents in Mayagüez chase after a loaded vessel with $5.4 million in cocaine onboard. AMO agents in Fajardo investigate a party boat and discover a passenger on board entered the country illegally.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: Molly, ecstasy rebranded as ultra-pure MDMA, is exploding as the new hot-selling drug. And with the growing popularity of electronic dance music, molly use has skyrocketed, overwhelming supply and driving prices to astronomical levels. National Geographic Channel brings you new-wave dealers who have found a solution to the exhausted supply in the form of a molly alternative that is yielding much greater profits. Straying from the traditional criminal network, these dealers reveal how they have turned to international distributors, ordering their product online. See how Customs and Border Protection fights to disrupt trafficking, as chemical factories create new ways to avoid detection. NGC follows law enforcement as they hunt for MDMA labs to shut down these operations. Finding a new market as a street drug, NGC uncovers that the once-pure drug has transformed into a corrupt chemical with potentially catastrophic side effects.

programme.title: Drugs Inc.
programme.desc: This episode of Drugs Inc pushes series 6 into exciting new directions with a show based around one event; New Year's Eve in New York City. The biggest party of the year brings unique opportunities for dealers wishing to make a lot of money but they have a new set of problems to contend with; fierce competition with other dealers, stick up kids who make a living robbing them and the law enforcement who are on full alert to make sure the night goes without a hitch.

programme.title: Trafficked with Mariana van Zeller
programme.desc: Mariana van Zeller goes inside the secretive world of outlaw motorcycle gangs, also known as 1% clubs, when her interest is piqued by a string of biker-related violence. Undeterred by a strict code of silence, she interviews members of three major clubs, as well as ATF agents and cartel contacts, to learn about the bonds of blood and brotherhood that fuel these groups.

programme.title: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Cyril and his team embark on an unprecedented adventure in the wildest, dangerous and unexplored regions of the world. Their mission: to find the last endangered species of giant fish and take samples for scientific purposes in order to better understand the exact causes of their disappearance. Their challenge: survive in hostile environments and extreme conditions to protect these impressive aquatic creatures.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: Where's Mom?. A hurricane sets two vastly different species on a collision course off the coast of North Carolina when a group of surfers paddle into waters patrolled by one of Earth's most ancient and deadly marine animals.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side
programme.desc: New Generations. Spring thaw heralds a time for new life and new opportunities after the icy winter. While Japan's macaques head back to the beaches, a host of creatures are getting started on procreating and rearing their young.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: This Is not a Deer!. In the Costa Rican jungle, a sudden strike turns a television producer's location scout into a race to save his leg and possibly his life. And in Orange County, California, a personal trainer becomes the second victim of an apex predator.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Sixth Sense. To win the game of life, it can take more than brute force. Animals with a super-powered sixth sense can get the edge on fast-moving prey, beat the elements, and find food in unlikely places.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Deception. From tigers who hunt using their fur as camouflage and a spider who mimics an ant to sneak into a colony to a bird that uses false alarm calls to trick meerkats into giving up their prey, nature deploys remarkable deception to survive.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly
programme.desc: Wild, Smart, and Deadly features the planet's most extraordinary animals as they deploy a range of astonishing, secret superpowers to vanquish their enemies, hunt down prey, attract a mate and survive in the wild.

programme.title: Something Bit Me!
programme.desc: Everything Went Dark.... A river guide in Zimbabwe meets his match in treacherous waters. Despite repeated maulings that leave him with 38 major bite wounds, he survives to tell his tale. In the Pacific Northwest, a civil servant suffers a very uncivilized fate.

programme.desc: Packed with a potent neurotoxic venom, one family of snakes kill more people than any other on earth. These are the elapids - a family that includes the the black mamba, the king cobra, the inland taipan, and the krait. Their venom is one of the most toxic substances on earth; but in a strange twist of fate, it can also save lives. Scientists around the world race to uncover the secrets of these killer snakes - without getting bitten in the process.

programme.title: Lion

Just as he finally finds his place among them, disaster tears the family apart, forcing Summer to make an extraordinary sacrifice to protect Kio's future.

programme.title: Africa's Deadly Kingdom
programme.desc: Africa's southern coastline hosts some of the most vibrant, varied and dynamic reef systems on the planet. Bizarre, beautiful and mysterious worlds, they are crammed with a bustling diversity of life. Ever changing, these coral gardens are amongst the most competitive and cutthroat of underwater environments. Africa's Deadly Kingdom: Reefs dives in to reveal the astounding adaptations of a multitude of marine creatures to life below the waves.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: With more than 19,000 patients, Dr. Pol has seen it all. programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

To meklējot Barbabravo, Barbabella un Barbagudrais zem dīvāna atrod dīvainu caurumu. Ja nu mašīna aizkrita līdz zemes centram?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Nē! Nē! Tas nav beidzies! Barbabravo nav mazs, viņš ir liels puika! No šis dienas viņš tā arī dzīvos - nekādu snaudu, uzkodu un spēlēšanās ar brāļiem un māsām. // Barbabērni pirmoreiz dodas uz lielveikalu. Tik daudz preču, lieliska vieta! Bet kāpēc viss satīts plastmasas plēvēs?

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Pēkšņi pa nakti pazudušas Barbazū skaistās rozes. Viņš ir drošs, ka vainīga Barbabella. Bet kā lai piedabū viņu atzīties? Barbatētis tādēļ nolemj bērniem pastāstīt par to, kā viņš un Lolita reiz devās ekspedīcijā uz Arktiku.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Mērei Greitvejai vajag daudz picas, un ātri! Bet, kad pieslēdzas Ātrmeistars, suņiem jānovērš viņa picas problēma. Kad ģimene pa Ātrmeistara ceļu nevar pagūt uz lidostu, Rabla komandai līdz izlidošanai jāuzbūvē jauns ceļš.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Mēre Greitveja un Dakija Dū kungs vēlas nodemonstrēt savas izpletņlēkšanas prasmes. Taču, kad patraucē vējš, suņi palīdz viņiem lēkt ar izpletni uz zemes! Kad Vīleram un cūkai Trifelei nesanāk slidot, komanda rod risinājumu uz riteņiem!

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Seriālā "Blū pavedieni tev" iemīļotais kucēns Blū aicina skatītājus pievienoties viņas un Džoša pavedienu piedzīvojumā, lai atrisinātu mīklu. Ar katru ķepas nospiedumu skatītājs tiek aicināts sadarboties ar Džošu un Blū, lai atrisinātu uzdevumu.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija apmaldās izklaides centrā. Tims meklē jaunu, sev piemērotu raķeti. Kad Terija pieskata bērnus, Tims cenšas apiet visus noteikumus.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Rabla iemīļotā beisbola zvaigzne netiek mājās, komanda uzbūvē stadionu, lai spēle notiktu turpat Celtnieklīcī. Kucēni gatavi sērfingam! Ja vien tiks pāri karstām smiltīm.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Seriālā "Blū pavedieni tev" iemīļotais kucēns Blū aicina skatītājus pievienoties viņas un Džoša pavedienu piedzīvojumā, lai atrisinātu mīklu. Ar katru ķepas nospiedumu skatītājs tiek aicināts sadarboties ar Džošu un Blū, lai atrisinātu uzdevumu.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Krokodilkungs un Deizija cenšas noskaidrot, kurš no draugiem aizņēmās spēli un neatgrieza to. Vai Pamātes diena izdosies, ir atkarīgs no tā, vai Deizija un Krokodilkungs atradīs bundžu attaisāmo.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabērni laimē skārienpaliktni. Visi grab to izmantot, tāpēc čiepj viens pēc otra. Barbazū krāj ūsainu slavenību bildes. Diemžēl nekur nevar atrast pēdējo: Čārlzu Pakavu-Ūsaini. Viņam ir aizdomas par sazvērestību...

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo aizmirsa nodot bibliotēkas grāmatu. Bibliotekārs Misters Stingrais šodien ciemojas pie Barbatēta, tāpēc Barbabo izlemj aizbēgt. Barbamamma grib, lai barbabērni uzkopj savas istabas. Viņi slēpjas, lai izvairītos no garlaicīgā darba.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tomijs piedalās raķešu sacīkstēs, Tims atbalsta savu brāli. Tims novērš Tijas domas no Taskija, kamēr tas mazgājas veļas mašīnā. Bērni kļūst par vecākiem, un vecāki - par bērniem.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims izzina Rūkoņtaunu, lai atrastu vietu, kur baudīt jautrību vienatnē. Tims un Kaja cenšas sarīkot Pārkijam neaizmirstamu dienu. Kad vētras dēļ Reksiem jāpaliek mājās, viņiem jāizdomā, kā pavadīt laiku.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims nolemj pierādīt, ka Kajas tētis ir kapteinis Dinostārs. Tims cenšas atpūsties, bet Tijai ir citi plāni. Tims nopērk labākos cepumus pilsētā, bet drīz saprot, ka citiem tos vajag vairāk nekā viņam.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad vējaina diena traucē būvēt saldējuma veikalu, Rabls, Miksa un Čārdžers ķeras pie darba. Rātsnamā kaut kas mistiski čīkst. Mērs Greitveja lūdz Rablam un Čārdžeram to atrast un salabot pirms viņas runas.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc tam, kad Ātrmeistars uzbūvējis nedrošu rotaļlaukumu, Rabla komandai jādomā radoši un jāuzbūvē jauns laukums no veciem materiāliem. Pilsētas Čili Kūkarū ir apdraudēts, kad sāk iebrukt Rātsnama jumts! Par laimi suņi zina, kā to salabot.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Sapratuši, ka pieaugušie mobilo māju kopienā īsti labi nepazīst viens otru, Deizija un Krokodila kungs nolemj sarīkot pikniku visai apkārtnei. Viņi uzaicina visus un uzstāj, ka par visu parūpēsies paši. Viņi vēlas, lai cilvēki koncentrētos uz iepazīšanos, nevis visa iekārtošanu. Bet, tuvojoties piknika laikam, viņi saprot, ka nevar visu izdarīt, un varbūt ļaut citiem palīdzēt ir labākais veids, kā iedraudzēties ar kaimiņiem.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Ātrmeistars nozog Rabla komandas autobusu, ķepaiņiem tas jāatgūst, lai paspētu uz Sjerras Spīdošās koncertu. Celtnieklīcī ir lieliska diena pludmalei! Rabla komandai jābūvē glābēju tornis, lai pludmalē būtu aboslūti droši.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad ceļojošā veterinārārste daktere Diva nevar laikā veikt visu Celtnieklīcī dzīvojošo dzīvnieku apskati, Rabla komanda zina, kā jārīkojas. Lilijas nāriņu ballīte tiek atsaukta, kad sāk līt. Laiks celtniecības risinājumam!

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Pēkšņi pa nakti pazudušas Barbazū skaistās rozes. Viņš ir drošs, ka vainīga Barbabella. Bet kā lai piedabū viņu atzīties? Barbazū viņai iedod jaunu lelli, kas viņu labāk pieskatīs. // Bērni ģimenes albumā ierauga Lolitas bērnības foto. Barbatētis tādēļ nolemj bērniem pastāstīt par to, kā viņš un Lolita reiz devās ekspedīcijā uz Arktiku.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Bērni pirmoreiz brauks ar vilcienu un nakšņos viesnīcā. Mamma būs ar viņiem, bet tētis atsevišķi vedīs paštaisītos izstrādājumus. Viņiem jāpārdod savi darbiņi ikgadējā lielajā tirdziņā, ja tētis paspēs laicīgi... // Uzsniga sniegs un bērni sarīkoja pikošanos, bet Barbabo uzcēla lielisku sniegavīru. Bet kā lai viņu saglabā, kad paliks siltāks? Sākas sacensības ar laiku...

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pastāsta pārējiem, cik vareni bija Da Vinči izgudrojumi un nu katrs grib izgudrot ko savu. Ģēniju ir maz, bet ir jautri izgudrot. // Bērniem jāizvēlas - doties baseinā vai izbraukt ar riteņiem. Uzreiz izveidojas divas frontes un tikai Barbazū spēj nosvērt izvēles svarus.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Blū draudzene Fuksija šodien nāk ciemos! Mēs spēlējam Blū pavedienus, lai uzzinātu, ko Blū vēlas darīt kopā ar Fuksiju. Meklējot pavedienus, mēs salīdzinām pretstatus un pētām dzīvnieku ķepu nospiedumus kopā ar draugiem Lāpstu un Spainīti.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Cūciņa Pepa ir mīļa, ziņkārīga un aktīva pirmskolniece, kura kopā ar māmiņu, tēti un brālīti Džordžu ik dienu uzzina daudz ko jaunu un aizraujošu. Pepas iecienītākās nodarbes ir rotaļāšanās, pārģērbšanās un lēkāšana pa dubļainām peļķēm, un viņas jautrie piedzīvojumi vienmēr beidzas ar skaļiem smieklu rukšķiem.

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Pilsētā ieradies karnevāls, un tā ir iespēja redzēt aizraujošas lietas! Tur ir Buļļa kunga džeza grupa, Trusītes jaunkundze kā karnevāla karaliene un pat ļoti īpaša Kartupeļa kunga parādīšanās, kurā viņš demonstrē savu lielo balonu!

programme.title: Cūciņa Pepa
programme.desc: Vecvecāku papagailis Pollija ierodas ciemos. Pepai un Džordžam patīk Pollija. Viņa ir jautra un atkārto visu, ko citi saka. Kad Pollija aizlido, neviens nezina, kā viņu atrast, līdz Džordžs izdomā gudru plānu.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Arvien jauni piedzīvojumi ar Doru! Piebiedrojies drošajai pētniecei Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu brīnumainajos piedzīvojumos - no došanās palīgā dzīvniekiem kopā ar Djego līdz apburtas nāru pasaules glābšanai.

programme.title: Dora
programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Martins ir uzbūvējis jaunu Bočes laukumu kopienai un rīko turnīru! Deizija un mamma apvienojas ar Krokodila kungu kā treneri, lai kopā pavadītu laiku kā māte ar meitu un krokodils. Taču, konkurencei kļūstot sīvākai, Deizija sāk uztraukties, ka, ja viņas neuzvarēs, viņa pievils mammu. Viņai jāatrod veids, kā nepievilt mammu, bet arī pateikt, kā viņa patiesībā jūtas.

programme.desc: Barbabo aizmirsa nodot bibliotēkas grāmatu. Bibliotekārs Misters Stingrais šodien ciemojas pie Barbatēta, tāpēc Barbabo izlemj aizbēgt.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kucēni ir sajūsmā, kad viņu mīļākā TV zvaigzne Henks Hammers grib redzēt, kā viņi strādā. Kapteinis Turbo ir sagādājis pārsteigumu. Kad saceļas migla, komandai ir jāuzceļ bāka.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Blū draudzene Fuksija šodien nāk ciemos! Mēs spēlējam Blū pavedienus, lai uzzinātu, ko Blū vēlas darīt kopā ar Fuksiju. Meklējot pavedienus, mēs salīdzinām pretstatus un pētām dzīvnieku ķepu nospiedumus kopā ar draugiem Lāpstu un Spainīti.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs, Tija un omīte ir dārgumu meklējumos. Ir Rūkoņas svētki, un Tims grib, lai viņa rūciens ir labākais. Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad Ātrmeistars uzbūvē atkritumu pārstrādes staciju pa savam, komandai jānovērš juceklis. Kad apmaldās pīlēns, Rabla komandai jārod risinājums, kā to vest mājās.

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Slēpošanas laikā Barbapapas uzceļ milzīgu iglū. Barbabravo and Barbalibs sacenšas drosmīgumā. Barbagudrais rada putekļu sūkšanas robotu, kas lieliski spēlē futbolu. Barbabērni sarīko spēli pret robotiem.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbagudrais pārklāj māju ar burvju produktu, lai novērstu ūdens sūci. Nākamajā dienā māja saplok kā balons. Putns uzvij ligzdu uz Barbazū vēdera. Barbazū grib kļūt par lieu koku, lai sniegtu patvērumu dzīvniekiem. Situācija kļūst sarežģīta.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims nolemj pierādīt, ka Kajas tētis ir kapteinis Dinostārs. Tims cenšas atpūsties, bet Tijai ir citi plāni. Tims nopērk labākos cepumus pilsētā, bet drīz saprot, ka citiem tos vajag vairāk nekā viņam.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Kaja meklē pludmalē apraktos niekus. Tims atbrīvojas no vecajām lietām, bet drīz saprot, ka ne visam vieta miskastē. Tims, Tija un Tomijs cenšas pārliecināt mammu un tēti par labu mīlulim.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Reksu ģimene dodas ceļojumā cauri galaktikai, lai nokļūtu Raķešpasaulē. Tims un Kaja cīnās par Terijas rezerves biļeti uz Kosmoslendu. Tims, Tija un Tomijs rīko talantu šovu, bet nevar izlemt, kurš uzstāsies pirmais.

programme.desc: Jauni piedzīvojumi ar DORU! Pievienojies drošajai pasaules pētītājai Dorai un viņas labākajam draugam Zābaciņam viņu kopīgajos ceļojumos pa maģisko lietusmežu, kurā var notikt - un notiek - brīnumu lietas. Let's go!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Ar sava burvju kuģa "El Bravo" un burvju rīku palīdzību Santjago vadīs savu drosmīgo komandu piedzīvojumos jūrā, lai pasargātu savu ģimeni un draugus. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims un Tija būvē laika mašīnu, lai nebūtu jāatklāj tētim patiesība. Tims dodas uz Dinostāra treniņu akadēmiju, bet ir neizpratnē par sava varoņa metodēm. Tēvocis Tibērijs apciemo Reksus, un Timam jāparāda, ka viņš māk uzvesties.

programme.title: Tims Rekss kosmosā
programme.desc: Tims, Tomijs un Tija savā mājā atrod pazudušu mamutu.

programme.title: Blū pavedieni tev
programme.desc: Ir Blū dzimšanas diena! Mēs spēlējam Blū pavedienus, lai uzzinātu, kādu dāvanu Blū vēlas saņemt dzimšanas dienā. Meklējot pavedienus, mēs palīdzam Džošam sagatavoties ballītei, vērojot notiekošo, un dodamies uz Džo dāvanu veikalu.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Ceļojumā uz Parīzi ģimene apskatīs lielisko Luvru. Diemžēl Barbalala neievēro strikto noteikumu - muzejā neēst. // Barbalala strikti ievēro ačgārnās dienas tradīcijas, kas cēlušās no seniem laikiem. Brāļi un māsas pievienojas viņai ačgārnajā dienā.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Barbabo aizmirsa nodot bibliotēkas grāmatu. Bibliotekārs Misters Stingrais šodien ciemojas pie Barbatēta, tāpēc Barbabo izlemj aizbēgt. Barbamamma grib, lai barbabērni uzkopj savas istabas. Viņi slēpjas, lai izvairītos no garlaicīgā darba.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Slēpošanas laikā Barbapapas uzceļ milzīgu iglū. Barbabravo and Barbalibs sacenšas drosmīgumā. Barbagudrais rada putekļu sūkšanas robotu, kas lieliski spēlē futbolu. Barbabērni sarīko spēli pret robotiem.

programme.title: Krokodila kungs
programme.desc: Džidžijai bija ļoti jautri ar savu draugu Ārtiju, kurš ciemojās, bet tagad viņam pienācis laiks doties mājās. Krokodila kungs un Deizija uztraucas, ka Džidžī būs vientuļa, kamēr Ārtija nebūs blakus. Draugi apņemas būt viņai blakus un nekad neļaut būt vienai. Bet visa šī uzmanība Džidžijai ir par daudz, un viņa cenšas atrast brīdi sev. Krokodila kungam un Deizijai ir jāiemācās, ka tas, ka kāds ir viens, nenozīmē, ka viņš ir vientuļš.

programme.title: Ķepaiņu lietas
programme.desc: Antropomorfisku dzīvnieku pasaulē Sems Snovs un Kita Keisija ir elitāri KLEID (Slepenā dzīvnieku detektīvu ekspertu līga) aģenti, kas apceļo pasauli un risina noslēpumus, liekot lietā problēmu risināšanas un dzīvnieku faktu pārzināšanas prasmes.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Pēc sniegota pārsteiguma pienākšanas, Rabla komanda piedāvā palīdzēt Hedlija viesnīcā. Kad kāpnes izrādās nepietiekami ātras, ir laiks celt. Karls adoptē kaķēnus. Kad viņi izraisa popkorna elli, Rabla komanda padara kafejnīcu kaķēniem draudzīgu.

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Reindžere Roza lūdz Rabla komandu salabot Lāču salas tiltu. Kad remontdarbos iejaucas Ātrmeistars, ķepaiņiem jāsatīra viņa radītā nekārtība un jāpasargā lāčus no ātri tuvojošās vētras... ar tantes Celtnes jaunās Būvētavas Bultas palīdzību.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!
programme.desc: Pēc piedzīvotām likstām Barbabravo vairs nemaz nespēj pārtapt. Visa ģimene dodas viņam palīgā.

programme.title: Ķepu patruļa
programme.desc: "Ķepu patruļa" ir seriāls pirmsskolas vecuma bērniem, kura galvenie varoņi ir seši varonīgi kucēni Čeiss, Māršals, Rokijs, Zuma, Rabls un Skaja, kuru saimnieks ir tehnoloģijas pārzinošais 10 gadus vecais zēns Raiders. Viņiem ir unikālas problēmu risināšanas spējas, stilīgi braucamrīki un daudz kucēniem raksturīga mīļa humora. "Kepu patruļa" dodas bīstamās glābšanas misijās, lai Piedzīvojumu līča iedzīvotāji būtu drošībā. Māršals – suns ugunsdzējs, Čeiss – suns policists, Skaja, kura lido savā helikopterā, un citi – katram kucēnam ir sava īpaša personība un spējas, atspoguļojot kopīga darba un pilsoniskās atbildības nozīmību. Viņiem visiem uz muguras ir īpašas mugursomas, lai viņi būtu spējīgi paveikt visu, sākot no kaķēnu glābšanas līdz vilciena apturēšanai, neļaujot tam nokrist no klints. Lai cik liels būtu piedzīvojums, "Ķepu patruļai" vienmēr atliek laiks spēlēm, jautrībai un tam, lai Raiders pakasa aiz auss. Interesants "Ķepu patruļas" fakts – Raders izglāba visus kucēnus un iemācīja tiem viņu spējas.

programme.title: Barbapapas - Lielā ģimene!

programme.title: Rabla komanda
programme.desc: Kad stirnai Podziņai jāšķērso Celtnieklīča lidostas skrejceļš, Rabls un komanda zina, kas jābūvē. Rabls un komanda uzbūvē milzu skrituļdēli tantes Celtnes un Rivera šovam. Taču, kad tas zaudē kontroli, suņiem jādzenas pakaļ!

programme.title: Jūras Santjago
programme.desc: Kapteinis Santjago, viņa varde Kiko, brālēns Tomass un nāra Lorelaja ir Enkanto salas pirāti-sargi. Taču kuģošana allaž nebūs mierīga, jo nāksies pārspēt viltībā negantus ļaundarus un negaidītus ienaidniekus.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When Leonardo finds himself the accidental hero in a subway station, saving the lives of innocent bystanders, he's thrilled by the title of HERO. This pushes him to a life of crime-fighting vigilantism, starting with putting the Purple Dragons in their place. But when he's caught on camera and his brothers and April see this Turtle-shaped hero on the news, they interrogate him: what's he up to... and can they get in on it? Now, the four Night Ninjas and April suit up and set out to rid the streets of crime in a single night. Now what's left to do? April finds a dog-napping ring that's been snatching up purebreds. Baiting the dog-nappers with a fancy pooch, the Turtles track the criminals and meet the villainous French florist known as... La Fleur! She and her band of hench-florists are using the dog-napping as a cover-up for a much larger crime. And when the Night Ninjas show up to stop her, it may be too late for Leo and his brothers as the whole thing goes up in flames... literally.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: After reading a book by the Twins' parents, Bibi learns about Marsupilamis and decides she wants one. The Twins deny Marsupilamis exist, but Bibi's convinced they have their own, so starts spying on them. Jade claims a tail that Bibi spots is just a hose, but Bibi wants proof. So Mica sends the Marsupilamis to fetch one-they try to steal Rosa's hose but it ends up getting lost, and whilst hunting for it Twister mistakes a Jaguar's tail for the hose. The Jaguar then follows them back home where they manage to trap it in their nest, where Bibi encounters it thinking it's a Marsup! Scared she declares she's sticking to Puppies in the future. // Lunch service at the school canteen is slow and Jade leads a chant to speed up the service. The the chef is offended and quits, and things then get worse as Marcel is hired, and his disgusting food quickly generates resentment towards Jade. With the help of the Marsups the old chef returns, and is so appalled by the food that she reclaims her job.

programme.title: Best and Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester are a pair of hilariously individual twins who live in a weird and wonderful alternate reality where your neighbour could be a pair of disgruntled trousers or your best friend a floating cloud of bottom burp. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: The Thundermans: Undercover
programme.desc: Still eager to impress Captain Perfect, Max volunteers to help him with his younger sister, a headstrong girl who seems to drawn to evil. Max tries to show her the benefits of being good, but she tricks him and heads to auditions for new Mastermind henchmen. Max disguises himself and goes the auditions, too, hoping to stop her from working for a supervillain. Both he and the young girl are chosen to prove their evil and destroy Splat by Sea, but Max reveals his identity to her and talks her out of being a villain just before the restaurant is ruined. Meanwhile, Phoebe convinces BC he needs an elaborate dance-posal to ask Chloe to the school dance, but her interference does more harm than good.

programme.title: Danger Force
programme.desc: This fun spin-off of Henry Danger is set in the Swellview Academy for the Gifted and follows the adventures of four young friends. Chapa, Miles, Bose and Mika were ordinary kids, until they discovered they have superpowers. They are recruited by Captain Man to become his new crime-fighting crew, and protect the city of Swellview from various villains. But before that Captain Man must teach them how to control their superpowers, as well as to how to work as a team, using Schwoz as his helper.

programme.title: Henry Danger
programme.desc: Henry Danger is a story about adventures of a 13-year-old Henry Hart who is lucky to become a helpmate of a super hero Captain Man. This is a real dream job of every teen. The newbie is getting paid for fighting against crime and helping to save the world. Brave Henry must hide his job from his family and friends and it is not that simple, but nothing can stop him from being a true crime-fighter. Henry himself wants to become a super hero one day, that is why he is constantly learning from Captain Man and is not scared of any hardships on the way to his dream.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
programme.desc: Deep down in the Pacific Ocean in the subterranean city of Bikini Bottom lives a square yellow sponge named SpongeBob SquarePants. SpongeBob lives in a pineapple with his pet snail, Gary, loves his job as a fry cook at the Krusty Krab, and has a knack for getting into all kinds of trouble without really trying. When he's not getting on the nerves of his cranky next door neighbor Squidward, SpongeBob can usually be found smack in the middle of all sorts of strange situations with his best buddy, the simple yet lovable starfish, Patrick, or his thrill-seeking surfer-girl squirrel pal, Sandy Cheeks.

programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Nine-year-old twins, Jade and Mica know Marsupilimis are real, as their explorer parents entrusted them with three precious eggs that hatched into Marsups named Hope, Twister, and Punch. They now live happily with the twins and their Gran Gran Suzanne above the family restaurant The Chahuta in Palombia, whilst the Twins parents search for the Marsups family. Living with three young Marsupilamis is an endless source of adventures. Jade and Mica love having having fun with them, but know, it's essential to keep their existence hidden from the outside world to keep them safe. Every day brings new challenges - taking the Marsupilamis to the park can quickly turn into a frantic race through the sewers and a confrontation with a wild jaguar, or a game of golf can result in capture by Stan the zoologist! Jade and Mica learn just as much from these fun furry creatures as the Marsupilamis learn from them - they make a great team and family!

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: On iCarly, Sam's tooth falls out, leading Carly to take Sam to the dentist. When the doctor gives Sam laughing gas, Sam accidentally reveals that she and Freddie shared a secret kiss with each other. Carly gets angry because friends aren't supposed to keep secrets, but in the end she is OK with it. Meanwhile, Spencer teaches an art class in a prison, he and the prisoners build a big pair of pants that two prisoners hide in and jump out in Carly's house and tape Carly Sam and Freddie to three chairs after Freddie threatens to call the Police.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: On iCarly, Sam and Freddie show their viewers how to make "Spaghetti Tacos". Food TV enjoyed their presentation, and called their apartment to tell them that they were going to be interviewed. During the interview, "Ricky Flame" comes in and challenges them to a "Food Fight", a parody of the real Throwdown! with Bobby Flay, competing over who can make the best Spaghetti Tacos. When the iCarly gang wins, Ricky is crushed, and quits cooking forever. The iCarly gang try to cheer him up by tempting him with cooking, but his head falls in the salad. Later, he sends them a video, telling them to meet him at the wrestling ring. When they get there, Ricky is wrestling little kids because he figured out that he doesn't like to cook, but he likes to win, and when he's fighting kids, there's no way he can lose. Then Sam brings him down, and the show ends. Meanwhile, Spencer has a vision of the future, that he will hug a character from Galaxy Wars when he is shocked by Sam's new 100 volt locker security system and goes to great measures to make sure it comes true.

programme.title: Victorious
programme.desc: Chaos is coming to Tori Vega's life. The 16 year old is starting at a new high school; but not just any school. This is Hollywood Arts, a performing arts school where crazy talented students learn how to become real artists.. Until now, Tori didn't think she had much talent of her own, and was content to live in the shadow of her older sister, Trina. Now, that's all about to change... if Tori can see herself in a new light, even a spotlight! But Hollywood Arts is still a high school, and Tori is still the new kid. She'll have to find new friends, do homework, and just try to fit in. Will Tori grab a starring role in her new life?

programme.title: Sam & Cat
programme.desc: Prepare to meet the strangest match made in bestie heaven -- Sam & Cat! Sam's loud, independent, and tough as nails, while Cat is sweet as pie and super flighty. But that doesn't stop this unlikely pair from becoming best buds and roomies! Together, they're a power duo with a love for fun and adventure -- it's just too bad that it doesn't come cheap. A booming out-of-home babysitting business quickly becomes the answer to their empty-pocket problems, but also an extra reason for countless wacky adventures to come!

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: Leo, Raph, Donnie and Mikey emerge from the sewers to face challenges alongside April O'Neil like never before. When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! No matter the obstacle, these heroes in a half shell are ready for action with heart and a whole lot of humor.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: When Carly has trouble finding a date to a dance, Sam asks for Seattle-area boys to apply to be her date. Meanwhile, Carly convinces Sam to ask Gibby to the dance since no one else did, but Sam becomes enraged when Gibby turns her down. Carly finally finds a boy, whom after the dance, she dumps for being so talkative. In the end, Carly and Freddie share a dance together at the Groovy Smoothie, which Sam walks in on. Upon seeing them, she silently leaves.

Distraught that the snack cake is ceasing production, Private urges a raid on the Winky Factory where the last remaining Winkies are rolling off the production line. Impressed by Private's passion, Skipper gives him command of the mission! The young penguin learns there's a heck of a lot to digest when leading a team. King Me: King Julien's archrival, Clemson, returns in another attempt to claim the lemur crown. This time the sneaky lemur has a document that "proves" King Julien is not the legitimate king because he wasn't born in Madagascar. A series of challenges to prove who's more kingly ensues, and the penguins try to stack the deck in Julien's favor by each switching brains with him. Simple, right? How could a plan like this possibly fail?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Laid Plaintains: It's a special day when Bada and Bing get a shipment of delicious plantains to eat. Although they jealously guard the African bananas, King Julien's determined to taste them too. He sneaks into the gorilla habitat while they sleep, and he and Marlene end up eating a few too many for the gorillas not to notice. Like all of them. When they realize what they've done they head for the hills as fast as their stolen car can take them. Can the penguins calm the savage beasts before they bash the banana bandits? P.E.L.T.: Skipper's losing it. His performance on the obstacle course is actually slowing down, so he has to trigger a special fitness test to prove he can still lead the squad. Kowalski takes over as Skipper excuses himself to go on his fitness quest. The brainy bird appears to do a bang-up job in the leadership role - are Skipper's days at the helm over but he's too chicken to admit it?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Best Foes: Kowalski invents an enemy detector. As is often the case, it doesn't work, and Skipper gets his own wires crossed when he smashes it. Old enemies are now friends and old friends are now enemies as the boss bird starts to systematically clean out the zoo with the help of his new friend Hans. King Julien gets into the act by becoming Skipper's friend too, going so far as to Congaga dance together. New BFF Hans is not happy with the new bromance, however. Could this be the opening the penguins need? Night of the Vesuviuses: The annual Zoo Snooze is here! Kids get to buy tickets for a zoo sleepover, a treat the animals look forward to every year! This year's going to be very different, however, when the rotten Vesuvius Twins buy up all the tickets themselves. The zoosters plan to turn the tables, though, and exact sweet revenge on the twins. The penguins, influenced by Private of course, can't let this happen, and it's a long night's journey into day as the penguins scramble to protect their one-time tormentors.
